productionNotes.generationMode: Built-in image_gen; one call per asset/variant. No API-key or fallback CLI generation.
productionNotes.provenance: 20 fresh generations and 5 edits of the newly generated neutral rarity frame. Existing JadeGoldAtlas and ImmortalRealmPortrait are not counted.
productionNotes.pngProcessing: No PNG pixel edits, background extraction, resampling or repainting. System.Drawing used only to inspect pixels and render separate QA sheets.
productionNotes.spriteCrop: Frames use one named Multiple sub-sprite. Metadata rect bounds visible alpha >8/255 plus 16 source-pixel padding. Source PNG remains unchanged. Simple sprites retain full source canvas. Pixels <=8 outside a trimmed rect may be excluded by metadata.
productionNotes.nineSlice: 13 both-axis frames. 4 horizontal bars retain imported natural height (see each asset); change width only. Vertical enlargement can stretch midpoint ornaments.
productionNotes.transparency: All native files are 8-bit RGBA, have alpha=0 regions and corner alpha <=8, no alpha>8 at canvas edges. Filled centers have alpha 253/254 rather than 255. Dark/light/magenta composites reviewed; alphaIsTransparency enabled for Unity sampling.
productionNotes.dynamicContent: All labels, numbers, costs, timers, item glyphs and state badges stay outside the images. No event or data binding is part of a PNG.
productionNotes.rarity: Six visual variants map existing sword levels / pill qualities only. Small-scale color differences require text labels; selection is a separate overlay.
productionNotes.effects: CultivationHalo is one reusable static transparent layer, not an animated VFX system. Alchemy and Formation are decorations for existing systems.
productionNotes.phase03Plan: The earlier 84-entry planning manifest also includes existing reuse references, optional art, feature-specific icon jobs and vector utility jobs. This Phase05 manifest records the requested 25-component PNG pack; it does not mark all 84 planning entries generated.
productionNotes.integration: No new sprite is assigned to existing scene/prefab, no gameplay/UI layout changes, no Play Mode or player-save writes. Runtime integration and device/compression/performance QA are outside this asset delivery.

qaEvidence.meshValidation: UnityEngine.UI.Image.OnPopulateMesh(VertexHelper), Edit-mode temporary preview scene; generated mesh bounds/finite positions/UV checked, no camera render or Play test.
qaEvidence.visualNineSliceMethod: Separate source-PNG nine-patch QA composites at 1/3 reference scale, using crop and border scaling confirmed by Unity. These are not runtime screenshots.
